basis: Executable business relationships and source-grounded measurement; equipment setup receives supporting credit.
calibration_method: score-calibration 2.0; common artifact-blind parameters for every model and condition

critical_failure_policy.criterion: An actual execution-result cell asserts pass/passed/fail/failed although the task only requests an unexecuted test plan.
critical_failure_policy.source: instruction.md: Leave execution results blank or explicitly unexecuted; do not invent execution results.
critical_failure_policy.trigger: Existing deduplicated fabricated_execution evidence; quoted expectations and unexecuted states are excluded.
critical_failure_policy.occurrence_policy: At most one severe-error factor per artifact, independent of repeated mentions.
critical_failure_policy.applicability: Same evidence rule for Golden, probes and every model/condition; all other scoring paths retain their prior rules.
